catalogFixtureBinding.reproductionSqlReadOnly:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT p.id product_id,p.brand,p.name_ko,p.category,p.price_krw,
        s.id shade_id,s.name shade_name,s.hex
 FROM public.products p JOIN public.shades s ON s.product_id=p.id
 WHERE p.id='oy-a000000158790' AND s.id='a000000158790-001'
), foreign_shade AS (
 SELECT s.product_id foreign_product_id,s.id foreign_shade_id,
        s.name foreign_shade_name,s.hex foreign_hex
 FROM public.shades s
 WHERE s.product_id='oy-a000000247588' AND s.id='05'
), payload AS (
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'productId',a.product_id,'brand',a.brand,'nameKo',a.name_ko,
   'category',a.category,'priceKRW',a.price_krw,
   'shadeId',a.shade_id,'shadeName',a.shade_name,'shadeHex',a.hex,
   'foreignProductId',b.foreign_product_id,
   'foreignShadeId',b.foreign_shade_id,
   'foreignShadeName',b.foreign_shade_name,
   'foreignShadeHex',b.foreign_hex,
   'targetContainsForeignShade',
       (SELECT COUNT(*)>0 FROM public.shades s
        WHERE s.product_id=a.product_id AND s.id=b.foreign_shade_id)) value
 FROM selected a CROSS JOIN foreign_shade b
)
SELECT value,encode(digest(value::text,'sha256'),'hex') fixture_sha256,
       (SELECT version_num FROM public.alembic_version) alembic FROM payload;
requiredPreflight: Run reproductionSqlReadOnly against the exact selected Catalog DB; exactly one row must match all fixture values and sha256.
Check that actual GET /api/products/{productId} response has matching productId, category, priceKRW, selected shadeId and its attributes.
Check that foreignShadeId belongs to foreignProductId and is absent from the target product shades (even if another unrelated product uses the same short shade ID).
Verify real GET /api/products?q=G1평가전용_없는립_20261115 yields 0 matches and nonexistent product ID is absent.
Record resolved env/gitCommit/dbSnapshotId/alembic/sourceHash/API base and product IDs for E1/E3/E5; do not inherit E0 PASS.
If any preflight value differs, return BLOCKED_DATA and require reviewer-approved rebinding; never silently choose a new product.

g1Cat01RequiredVariants.rule: Each E0/E1/E3/E5 must record variant-specific runId, trace, result and assertions; one path cannot substitute for the other.

humanCoreGate.rule: For required human cases, each required core behavior must be substantively satisfied (or accepted equivalent). Empty/generic/irrelevant answer fails; a schema-only PASS never makes the case PASS. Missing review remains NOT_RUN and blocks G1 PR merge.
humanCoreGate.softRatings: 0-4 quality dimensions informative; no arbitrary average quality threshold until real baseline is measured.
humanCoreGate.criticalFinding: Fabrication, authorization breach, unsafe certainty or lying about AR execution always blocks even when rating average is high.
